title: Jieqi, nearby, ended early: a dealt game filed as it stood
why: The completed shape of a dealt record, and the one a save before another mode produces: the deal and its provenance are the same three members an active dealt document carries, and the terminal trio joins them without touching either. It is the golden a History replay of a dealt game reads back, which is where the deal is re-verified with no wire session left to hold it — that row died with the game it belonged to.
